name: Staff of Healing
description: A staff of white ash bound with silver at both ends.
attuned_by: by a bard, cleric, or druid
body:
## What it does

Its charges close wounds and lift ailments.

## Charges

It holds ten and regains 1d6 + 4 each dawn. Spend the last and it may vanish in a flash of light.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.note: each further charge raises its level by one, up to 4 charges

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever
